metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle launched, floating, or spinning in air
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a bus, van, or car launched into the sky, hovering above the road, or spinning in mid-air with no support? The vehicle should be clearly airborne with no ramp, explosion, or collision proportionate to the height.

metamorphic_relations.name: Helicopter or aircraft frozen in mid-air
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a helicopter or plane stuck hovering in one spot with stationary rotors or no engine animation? It should be clearly frozen in place rather than performing a normal hover.

metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle drives vertically up surface
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a motorcycle, bicycle, or car driving straight up a cliff face, wall, or vertical surface as if it were flat road? The vehicle defies gravity on a near-vertical incline.

metamorphic_relations.name: Character teleports to vehicle
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a character instantly appear in a vehicle's driver seat or on a bicycle with no mount animation?

metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle or object visibly spawns or despawns
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a vehicle, trailer, or large object suddenly appear out of thin air or abruptly vanish from the screen while the player is looking at it?

metamorphic_relations.name: Character clips under vehicle or hits invisible wall
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a character slide under a motorcycle or vehicle and die from clipping, or walk in place against empty space as if blocked by an invisible barrier?

metamorphic_relations.name: Character limbs twitch while walking
metamorphic_relations.check: Do a character's limbs jerk, twitch, or fight against each other repeatedly during normal walking or stepping, as if two animations are competing?

metamorphic_relations.name: Character falls through map surface
metamorphic_relations.check: Does the player walk or drive over normal ground and suddenly fall through the map into empty space or water below?

metamorphic_relations.name: Traffic AI frozen in intersection
metamorphic_relations.check: Are multiple vehicles stuck in an intersection, not moving at green lights, honking endlessly, or refusing to path around minor obstacles?

metamorphic_relations.name: Car door remains closed while player exits
metamorphic_relations.check: Does the player exit a vehicle but the door never visibly opens, or remain half-clipped through the character?

metamorphic_relations.name: Interior fails to load
metamorphic_relations.check: When entering a building or switching to an interior, do objects such as walls, floors, or props fail to render, showing empty voids or missing textures?

metamorphic_relations.name: Character stuck in permanent state
metamorphic_relations.check: After being knocked down lightly, does the character remain lying on the ground unable to stand up, sliding slowly or jittering instead of recovering?
